edges.reason: _to parameter flows into BasicToken.transfer destination
_value parameter flows into BasicToken.transfer amount
msg.sender used to index balances and to enforce require(_value <= balances[msg.sender]) in transfer
transfer subtracts from and adds to the balances mapping
transfer calls SafeMath.sub on balances[msg.sender] before writing
transfer calls SafeMath.add on balances[_to] before writing
_owner parameter flows into BasicToken.balanceOf lookup
balanceOf reads the balances mapping
local balance is returned by balanceOf
Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner on transferOwnership
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable, privileged state change
_from parameter flows into StandardToken.transferFrom
_to parameter flows into StandardToken.transferFrom
_value parameter flows into StandardToken.transferFrom
msg.sender used to index allowed[_from][msg.sender] allowance check in transferFrom
transferFrom debits and credits the balances mapping
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from the allowed mapping
_spender parameter flows into approve
_value parameter flows into approve
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] keyed by msg.sender
approve directly overwrites the allowance, enabling the known allowance race condition
_owner parameter flows into allowance
_spender parameter flows into allowance
allowance reads the allowed mapping
_spender parameter flows into increaseApproval
_addedValue parameter flows into increaseApproval
increaseApproval writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] keyed by msg.sender
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add on the existing allowance
SafeMath.add result is written into the allowed mapping, guarding overflow
increaseApproval updates the allowed mapping
_spender parameter flows into decreaseApproval
_subtractedValue parameter flows into decreaseApproval
decreaseApproval writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] keyed by msg.sender
local oldValue holds the current allowance in decreaseApproval
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub on oldValue
decreaseApproval writes the reduced allowance back into the allowed mapping
parameter a flows into SafeMath.mul

local c holding a*b is assert-checked against overflow in SafeMath.mul
parameter a flows into SafeMath.div
parameter b flows into SafeMath.div

parameter a flows into SafeMath.add
parameter b flows into SafeMath.add
local c holding a+b is assert-checked against overflow in SafeMath.add
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner on destroy

onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner on destroyAndSend

_recipient parameter is passed directly to selfdestruct in destroyAndSend

onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner on unpause
unpause writes paused = false to the paused state variable
